before: The restaurant's web address now forwards to an unrelated website, so customers who type it never reach Victoria
There is no working place online to see the dishes, the phone number or the address together
The words on this concept come from the Visit Aiken listing; prices, hours and photos would come from the owner
after: A working page, today: phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
HTTPS that renews itself, with nothing to patch or let lapse
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for the full menu with prices, hours and photos of the plates once the restaurant supplies them
